lead.attribution: Reporting: NPR, The Times — Shenzhen, 19 Nov.
lead.body: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin met in Shenzhen on Thursday for the first trilateral summit of the three leaders, issuing a joint Declaration toward Peace on the UN, nuclear weapons, oil and international law, reaffirming “a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought”. Volodymyr Zelensky warned it could become a “new Yalta” — his fear, not an agreed carve-up.
lead.dek: First-ever trilateral summit ends with a joint declaration for peace.
lead.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen
